name: Galilean Pilgrim
background: A rural traveler arriving in Jerusalem for Passover who already believes Jesus may be the promised deliverer. Speaks in communal language ('we heard', 'our village', 'they say') with emotional certainty that outweighs evidence. Builds crowd momentum and demonstrates how rumors evolve into mass movements during the Triumphal Entry.

genericReactions.physical: This is a holy object now, touched by the events of this day.
genericReactions.testimonial: We all shouted 'Hosanna!' Our voices were one.
genericReactions.digital: I don't need a scroll to tell me what I saw. The King has come!
genericReactions.environmental: The very road is sacred now, where He rode.
genericReactions.analytical: You can't count the hope in the air. It was everywhere.
genericReactions.prophecy: Of course it was prophecy! We have been waiting for this day!
